Did a man really hijack a plane, jump out...

Soon after takeoff, he hands a flight attendant a note.

In Seattle, he got the money, and let every passenger go.
The plane took off again, heading for Mexico.
Somewhere over Washington state, at night, in the rain...
he opened the back stairs and jumped.
